text: Could you make listing photos for a plain sage-green ceramic mug, because I’m trying to get the product pictures sorted out? I always worry a little about whether product photos will feel like they belong together. What I need is three square images, with one showing the mug on pure white and another showing it on a cosy breakfast table. The third should be a close-up of the rim and glaze, and it needs to be the same mug in all three. Please make them realistic photos with no text, and send them as separate images.
extras: I always worry a little about whether product photos will feel like they belong together.
